cell_simulation.method: THE OUTCOME IS THE CELL: the worktree's compare-deals.ps1 run twice over identical live inputs (main checkout out\regular, every out\sams\sams-deals file, ads-2026-09-17, bakers-deals-2026-09-09, fareway-deals-2026-09-17; -MinStores 1, no -IdentityNamespace), once per commodities.json, each into its own scratch -OutDir, then diffed cell by cell (commodity|store -> per_unit and item) and crown by crown
cell_simulation.control: live comparison-2026-09-17 (15:46:51) vs the BEFORE arm: 28 of 3,189 cells differ, all Fareway, every one dearer in the arm (sale rows the live build applied and the worktree's committed support files did not); 1 crown (balsamic-vinegar). The same gap sits in BOTH arms, so it cannot manufacture or hide an effect of the rule change except on a Fareway cell, and the only Fareway row the change routes (Doritos or Miss Vickie's, tortilla-chips, 0.3247/oz sale) is dearer than the LIVE Fareway tortilla-chips cell (0.2129).
